text:
The statement as relate 1.0.1 prints it in four of its output modes, rendered from this page's recorded result by the terminal's renderers, which match the relate 1.0.1 binary byte for byte on the recorded runs, timing values aside. The recording keeps no timings, so each one shows as `<ms>`; relate prints the milliseconds of its own run, and the live terminal prints the engine's. Exit code 0, as relate 1.0.1 returns it.

`--mode table` prints seven lines on stdout:

```bash
relate --read-only --mode table "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
+---------+
| name    |
+---------+
| "Ada"   |
| "Grace" |
| "Noor"  |
+---------+
```

`--mode envelope` prints one line on stdout:

```bash
relate --read-only --mode envelope "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
{"columnTypes":["STRING"],"columns":["name"],"notifications":[],"planCache":"miss","rows":[{"name":"Ada"},{"name":"Grace"},{"name":"Noor"}],"timings":{"elapsed_ms":<ms>,"execute_ms":<ms>,"lex_parse_ms":<ms>,"lower_ms":<ms>,"parse_ms":<ms>,"plan_ms":<ms>,"result_generation_ms":<ms>,"rewrite_ms":<ms>},"truncated":false}
```

`--mode jsonl` prints three lines on stdout:

```bash
relate --read-only --mode jsonl "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
{"name":"Ada"}
{"name":"Grace"}
{"name":"Noor"}
```

`--mode toon` prints eight lines on stdout:

```bash
relate --read-only --mode toon "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
rows[3]{name}:
  Ada
  Grace
  Noor
timings:
  {"elapsed_ms":<ms>,"execute_ms":<ms>,"lex_parse_ms":<ms>,"lower_ms":<ms>,"parse_ms":<ms>,"plan_ms":<ms>,"result_generation_ms":<ms>,"rewrite_ms":<ms>}
planCache:
  miss
```

Under a detected agent harness, relate prints at most 100 rows per statement; this statement returns three rows, so the cap leaves it whole.
